newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Ormat and Israel Electric Corp in power deal.
newsitem.headline: Ormat and Israel Electric Corp in power deal.

text.p: Ormat Industries signed an agreement to supply Israel Electric Corp (IEC) with electricity from a shale-fired power plant in southern Israel due to come on line in three years, IEC said.
"The power plant will run on technology developed by Ormat over the past five years," the IEC statement quoted Ormat chairman Yehuda Bronicki as saying.
The statement did not say how much the deal was worth.
Under the deal Israel Electric can continuously draw on 30 megawatts of power-producing capacity from the plant once the operation is on line.

Earlier this year, the Israeli government approved a new electricity law enabling private power companies to supply up to 10 percent of all national demand, which is expected to rise to 900 megawatts within the next five years.
